prompt: I'd like Increase font size and Decrease font size in the palette, so I can make the selected text bigger or smaller a step at a time without typing a number. They change every text layer in the selection, each from its own size, and leave other layers alone. They're offered only when the selection includes a text layer. The text box should grow or shrink to fit, as it does when I type a size, and one Undo takes a whole step back.
reference: Steps each selected text layer to the next size on the type scale (8, 9, 10, 11, 12, 14, 16, 18, 20, 24, 28, 32, 36, 48, 64, 72, 96; 1 px below it, 8 px above), setting the height as a typed size does, in one batch.

naive.summary: Adds or takes away 1 px per step, as the prototype did, so 16 goes to 17.
